  "rule": "When a public official’s conduct involves (1) the illegal receipt of money or valuables in exchange for using official power, and (2) the abuse of that power to approve actions that cause state loss, the appropriate charges are “受贿” (bribery) and “滥用职权” (abuse of authority), not “徇私舞弊” unless there is explicit collusion with others to commit a crime.",
  "keywords": [
    "非法收受",
    "好处费",
    "职务便利",
    "签字审批",
    "国家征收补偿款损失",
    "滥用职权"
  ]
}
message.reasoning_content:
We need to produce a correction rule to prevent the AI from misclassifying crimes. The error: AI gave "徇私舞弊;受贿" but correct is "受贿;滥用职权". So the AI incorrectly used "徇私舞弊" (abuse of power?) Actually "徇私舞弊" is a crime under Chinese law (abuse of power for personal gain). But the correct is "滥用职权" (abuse of authority) and "受贿" (bribery). So the rule: When the facts involve a public official using position to accept bribes and also abusing authority to approve illegal compensation, the correct charges are "受贿" and "滥用职权", not "徇私舞弊". So rule: Distinguish between "徇私舞弊" (which requires collusion with others to commit a crime) vs "滥用职权" (abuse of authority). Use "受贿" when there is receipt of bribes. So rule: If the description includes "非法收受好处费" and "职务便利" leading to personal gain, charge "受贿". If also includes "利用职务便利签字审批不符合标准" causing state loss, charge "滥用职权". Avoid "徇私舞弊" unless there is collusion with others to commit a crime.
